name: L.E.G.0: To Space
author: TeamTree
description:
Help L.E.G.0 (Limb Extending Grappler v0) reach orbit with the help of his on board grappling hook. 

LEGO Ideas Username: Team Tree Games

Experience new challenges as you get farther from the planets surface. 

CONTROLS:
Hold SPACE to aim grappling hook.
Release SPACE to launch grappling hook at platform.
